description_en: Create an adaptation request for an application version
description_zh: 为某个应用版本创建适配请求
kebab_example: aliyun cgcs create-adaptation --app-version-id 14320000 --adapt-target FrameRate=30 StartProgram=/example/example.exe BitRate=30 Resolution=1080p --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAdaptation

fields.description_en:
Start program.

Supports Unicode characters, with a maximum of 512 characters.

> This parameter is required when `AppType` is `end_game`, `hand_game`, or `render_app`.
fields.description_zh:
